query:
SELECT 
    id,
    title,
    propertyType,
    district,
    price,
    currency,
    bedrooms,
    bathrooms,
    area,
    ownerPhone,
    ownerWhatsapp,
    ownerEmail,
    ownerName,
    sourceUrl,
    portal,
    address
FROM properties
WHERE 
    district LIKE '%Surco%'
    AND bedrooms = 3
    AND area > 200
    AND price < 100000
LIMIT 5;
